sb.name: Joster Mareet
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.desc: Joster Mareet ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Joster Mareet can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, Joster Mareet loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Claw (Fiend Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: One humanoid Joster Mareet can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys Joster Mareet's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for the next 24 hours. Joster Mareet can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.desc: Joster Mareet kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: Joster Mareet magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eldritch horror makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the eldritch horror isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The eldritch horror exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The eldritch horror makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the eldritch horror, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the eldritch horror's turns. A eldritch horror can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the eldritch horror takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the eldritch horror must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the eldritch horror. If the eldritch horror dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The eldritch horror casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (save DC 14):

- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Blur|blur]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Project Image|project image]]

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Kavoda carries a spell scroll of [[Tools/Spells/Magic Weapon|magic weapon]] and a potion of giant strength (hill).

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: Kavoda has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Kavoda has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Kavoda's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] (self only)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Blur|blur]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]]

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

sb.name: King Jhaeros
sb.damage_immunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands Common, Draconic, Elvish, and Ignan but can't speak

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever Jhaeros is subjected to fire damage, he takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc: Whenever Jhaeros starts its turn with 60 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, Jhaeros goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, Jhaeros attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, Jhaeros attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once Jhaeros goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: Jhaeros is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Jhaeros has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Jhaeros's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Ashen Creature
traits.desc: When Jhaeros drops to 0 hit points, he explodes in a harmless cloud of ashes, leaving nothing else behind.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jhaeros makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell or other magic.

actions.name: Haste (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Until the end of its next turn, Jhaeros magically gains a +2 bonus to its AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its slam attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Markos makes two Ceremonial Blade attacks, two Psychic Orb attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Ceremonial Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Psychic Orb
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Markos casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Arms Of Hadar|arms of Hadar]], [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]]

bonus_actions.name: Swap Space
bonus_actions.desc: Markos targets one Medium or Small creature he can see within 30 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or it teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, exchanging positions with Markos.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: Naevys Tharesso has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Naevys Tharesso makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Flame Tongue Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands. Naevys Tharesso can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. While the sword is ablaze, it deals an extra 2d6 fire damage to any target it hits. The flames last until she uses a bonus action to speak the command word again or until she drops or sheathes the sword.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: For 1 minute, Naevys Tharesso can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand Naevys Tharesso. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if Naevys Tharesso is incapacitated.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Naevys Tharesso adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Naevys Tharesso must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Nixylanna Vidorant
sb.languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During its first turn, Nixylanna Vidorant has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Nixylanna Vidorant scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Nixylanna Vidorant is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Nixylanna Vidorant instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Nixylanna Vidorant deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Nixylanna Vidorant that isn't incapacitated and Nixylanna Vidorant doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Nixylanna Vidorant makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Prisoner 13
sb.languages: Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, Thieves' cant, Undercommon

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: In an area of antimagic, Prisoner 13's tattoos and reactions don't function, and she suffers the following modifications to her statistics: her AC becomes 13, she loses her immunity to psychic damage and the charmed condition, and her Tattooed Strike becomes a melee attack that deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

traits.name: Mindlink Tattoos
traits.desc: Prisoner 13 has telepathic links with dozens of agents operating throughout the land. The links allow Prisoner 13 to communicate telepathically with each of these agents while they are both on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Mountain Tattoo
traits.desc: Prisoner 13's AC includes her Constitution modifier.

traits.name: Shroud Tattoo
traits.desc: Prisoner 13 can't be targeted by divination spells or any feature that would read her thoughts, and she can't be perceived through magical scrying sensors. She can't be contacted telepathically unless she allows such contact.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Prisoner 13 makes two Tattooed Strike attacks.

actions.name: Tattooed Strike
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Firestorm Tattoo (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Prisoner 13 magically unleashes flame from the tattoo across her back, filling a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on her. Each other creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 13 (3d8) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: River Tattoo
actions.desc: Prisoner 13 magically ends any effects causing the grappled or restrained conditions on herself. If she is bound with nonmagical restraints, she slips out of them.

reactions.name: Readiness
reactions.desc: When a creature Prisoner 13 can see within 60 feet of herself ends its turn, Prisoner 13 makes one Tattooed Strike attack or uses River Tattoo. She can then move up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

sb.name: Rilago
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.languages: any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: Rilago can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Rilago can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: Rilago enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Rilago that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: One humanoid that Rilago can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Rilago; Rilago then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Rilago now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Rilago can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Rilago ends it as a bonus action, or Rilago is turned or forced out by an effect like the [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]] spell. When the possession ends, Rilago reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: Sabrina Kilgore has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Sabrina Kilgore's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sabrina Kilgore makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sabrina Kilgore makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Fear of Frogs and Toads
traits.desc: Sythian is frightened while he is within 20 feet of a frog or a toad (of any size) that he can see.

traits.name: Graz'zt's Gift
traits.desc: Sythian's AC includes his Charisma modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sythian makes two Poisoned Shortsword or Poisoned Dart attacks and uses Whispers of Azzagrat.

actions.name: Poisoned Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Whispers of Azzagrat
actions.desc: Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from Sythian must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Sythian casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]

reactions.name: Fiendish Rebuke (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of Sythian hits him with an attack roll, Sythian forces that creature to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: The Stranger
sb.damage_resistances: damage from spells; nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing (from stoneskin)

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: The Stranger wears an invisible ring of mind shielding that thwarts magical attempts to read their thoughts. The Stranger also wears dimensional shackles but is eager to be rid of them. One touch from Omid's mace-key causes the shackles to fall off, freeing the Stranger.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Stranger has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Stranger is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The Stranger can cast [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]] and [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Shield|fire shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Stoneskin|stoneskin]]*
- **5th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cone Of Cold|cone of cold]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|wall of force]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Globe Of Invulnerability|globe of invulnerability]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]]
- **8th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]]*
- **9th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Time Stop|time stop]]

*The Stranger casts these spells on itself before combat.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Force Field
traits.desc: Tockworth generates a magical force field around herself. This force field has 15 hit points and regains all its hit points at the start of each of Tockworth's turns, but it ceases to function if Tockworth drops to 0 hit points. Any damage Tockworth takes is subtracted from the force field's hit points first. Each time the force field regains hit points, the following conditions end on Tockworth: grappled, restrained, and stunned.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Tockworth makes three Shortsword or Lightning Discharge attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage.

actions.name: Lightning Discharge
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (3d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Tockworth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] (self only)
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Blur|blur]]

bonus_actions.name: Scalding Steam (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Tockworth emits a jet of piping-hot steam in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that cone must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Tixie's Shield Guardian
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10
sb.languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

traits.name: Bound
traits.desc: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The guardian makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.desc: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the guardian's amulet, the guardian grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the guardian is within 5 feet of the wearer.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: Tosh Starling has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Tosh Starling makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of its turns, Tosh Starling can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Tosh Starling deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Tosh Starling that isn't incapacitated and Tosh Starling doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.desc: Tosh Starling makes two melee attacks.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Tosh Starling makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: Zala Morphus has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zala Morphus makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rotting Gaze
actions.desc: Zala Morphus targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against this magic or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Weird Insight
actions.desc: Zala Morphus targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must contest its Charisma (Deception) check against Zala Morphus's Wisdom (Insight) check. If Zala Morphus wins, it magically learns one fact or secret about the target. The target automatically wins if it is immune to being charmed.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zorhanna Adulare has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Zorhanna Adulare is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Zorhanna Adulare can cast [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]] and [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Shield|fire shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Stoneskin|stoneskin]]*
- **5th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cone Of Cold|cone of cold]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|wall of force]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Globe Of Invulnerability|globe of invulnerability]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]]
- **8th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]]*
- **9th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Time Stop|time stop]]

*Zorhanna Adulare casts these spells on itself before combat.
